confidence_notes: I based the food and drink anchors on three web searches. Two searches found mostly aggregator data for Udaipur (cost-of-living sites, some updated October 2026), and those sources do not fully agree. Inexpensive meals came out at about $2–3.30, cappuccino at $1.60–2.00, and mid-range dinner for two at $12–19. The sources gave beer at about $1.50–3.70. Draft beer is uncommon in Udaipur, so the beer anchor reflects a standard serving of domestic beer in a restaurant, priced toward the upper middle of that range. The cocktail anchor uses an Expatistan figure for Udaipur of about ₹954, which Expatistan itself calls a guess and which was last updated in January 2024. I found no wine-by-the-glass prices for Udaipur. The wine anchor is therefore less certain: it is based on how wine relates to beer and cocktail prices locally, Indian hotel bar menus from other cities (about ₹800–1,150 plus tax), and lower prices at casual tourist restaurants. The accommodation anchors are model estimates from general knowledge only. I did not search for them or check live listings. They allow for July being monsoon low season, when room rates in Udaipur tend to be lower. The 3-star rate is the most uncertain because lakeside and heritage properties cost much more.
comparable_city_reasoning: I compared Udaipur with other tourist-heavy cities in Rajasthan, such as Jaipur and Jodhpur. Food in Udaipur is cheap by Indian standards, but alcohol and lakeside or tourist-area venues cost more because of Rajasthan excise duty and tourist demand.
